28421.d: Underground Pass is a quest named after the location in which it takes place.

gt.heading: Getting in and across the bridge
gt.text:
Enter the dungeon and you'll see three paths branching off in different directions.

Do not try to take the middle path as the unstable ground can potentially drag you down and send you tumbling down a very painful hillside, dealing around 140 damage, that you'll have to climb back up again. 

Instead, take either of the other paths. Climb over the rockslides to go around the swamp and get to where Koftik is standing next to a fire. There is a stone tablet near the beginning. It contains an eerie text that you may read if you wish. Several more tablets will be encountered later on, written to celebrate Iban and his supposed heritage.

Talk to him and he'll tell you it looks like there have been others in the cave already. He tells you that he found a damp cloth along with a book, The Diary of Randas.

Use the damp cloth on an arrow to make unlit fire arrow. Then light the unlit fire arrow, or use the arrow on the fire nearby to get a lit fire arrow. It's recommended to use cheaper arrows, as their type makes no difference and it cannot be recovered.

Equip the bow and fire arrow. Move into the small room to your north. Look across the chasm and you can see where the guide rope holds up the bridge. Fire your lit arrow at the rope. If you try to shoot the arrow on the bridge guide rope from where Koftik is, you will get a message saying you can't get a clear shot. If you succeed, the bridge will drop and you'll automatically walk across it.

Do not pull the lever next to the wall past the bridge unless you want to leave. It will drop the bridge and send you back. Moving on will take another arrow.

If you did not bring a plank with you, take the one nearby before proceeding. It can be used to safely pass some of the traps later.

28423.d: The Underground Pass is an old cave system that linked up an ancient portal, the Well of Voyage, to the elven lands of western Gielinor, Tirannwn.

gt.heading: Travelling through
gt.text:
The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.

The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.

Travelling through Underground path

To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.

These items are needed:
• A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
• A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
• A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
• Food to survive traps and monsters

Part 1

Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
• Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
• Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
• Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
• Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
• Go to the north.
• Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
• Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
• Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
• Continue going south, then east.
• Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
• Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
• You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass 
• Once past the spike traps, pull the [[Lever (Underground path, portcullis)

Part 2
• Head west towards the [[Cage (Underground path, slave)

Part 3
• Go past the smashed cage and pass through the [[Tunnel (Underground Pass)

Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
• After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
• If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
• After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs. 
• If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
• Heading south, cross the third walkway.
• Jump over the [[Bridge (Iban's lair)

28440.d: The Underworld, known as Niflheim to the Fremennik, and occasionally referred to as the Grim Underworld, is a realm parallel to Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The entrance to the Underworld is found deep beneath the surface of Gielinor, through the gates across the River Noumenon, the river that marks the boundary between the land of the living and the dead. It may be accessed through Death's door in his office. Another passage to the Underworld can be found in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, called the First Gate. It leads to the necromancer Oreb, who appears to control the crossing. Further access down the crossing is blocked by two barriers. Within the Underworld lies the City of Um, formed from memories of the souls residing within before they decide to pass on to their afterlife of choice, leaving the Well of Souls.

Gielinor's Underworld serves its function for that world alone, with other worlds having their own underworlds. Those with especially strong attachments to another world may find themselves drawn to that world's Underworld instead, as is the case with the Fremennik. Underworlds are also not to be confused with afterlives. Whereas each world has only one Underworld, they have a nigh-infinite amount of afterlives within them, created from the beliefs and unconscious expectations of the souls that inhabit them.

Within the Underworld can be found Underworld rocks, from which can be derived a unique Underworld metal, and Underworld roots, which are composed of a unique kind of wood.
